kv3.10:3.1: Nanu asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro ti?
kv3.10:3.3: Atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan ti?
kv3.10:4.2: hañci asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.10:4.3: "Atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan ti."
kv3.10:4.6: ‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro,'no ca vattabbe
kv3.10:4.7: ‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan ti,"' micchā.
kv3.10:5.2: "Atthi devesu asaṃvaro yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan ti," no vata re vattabbe
kv3.10:5.3: "Asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro ti."
kv3.10:5.5: "Vattabbe kho ‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro,' no ca vattabbe
kv3.10:5.6: ‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan ti,"' micchā. 3.
kv3.10:6.1: Atthi manussesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaro ti?
kv3.10:6.3: Atthi devesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaro ti?
kv3.10:7.1: Atthi devesu saṃvaro, n' atthi tattha asaṃvaro ti?
kv3.10:7.3: Atthi manussesu saṃvaro, n' atthi tattha asaṃvaro ti?
kv3.10:12.1: Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, atthi tattha pāṇātipāto ti?
kv3.10:12.3: Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, atthi tattha pāṇātipāto ti?
kv3.10:13.1: Atthi manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānan ti?
kv3.10:13.3: Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānan ti?
kv3.10:14.1: Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, n' atthi tattha pāṇātipāto ti?
kv3.10:14.3: Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, n' atthi tattha pāṇātipāto ti?
kv3.10:15.1: Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī, n' atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānan ti?
kv3.10:15.3: Atthi manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī, n' atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānan ti?
kv3.10:16.3: Sabbe devā pānāṭipātino adinnādāyino kāmesu micchācārino musāvādino surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyino ti?
kv3.10:16.5: Tena hi atthi devesu saṃvaro ti.
